Container.Name: OpenBot
Container.Overview: OpenBot for Unraid provides a complete runtime and management platform for OpenBot wheeled robots. Features automated multi-arch deployment, hardware passthrough for USB microcontrollers (Arduino/ESP32), V4L2 cameras, Bluetooth LE, and GPU hardware video acceleration.
Container.Changes: [b]v1.0.0[/b] - Initial production release for Unraid OS - Multi-arch support for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 - Dynamic PUID/PGID user mapping (nobody:users) - Integrated USB Serial, Camera, and GPU DRI hardware passthrough

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Primary network port for the OpenBot WebUI, REST API, and WebSockets

Config.Description: Path to persistent configuration files, credentials, and robot profiles

Config.Description: Storage location for ML models, telemetry logs, and video recordings
